fields.transaction_id: deterministic transaction key built from borough, block, lot, sale date, and price; street address is excluded
fields.building_class_category: NYC Department of Finance class category
fields.sale_price: recorded sale price in nominal US dollars
fields.year_built: reported construction year; zero means unavailable

interpretation_boundary: Administrative sales records do not establish arm's-length status, property condition, lease income, operating expenses, financing terms, appraisal value, or investability.
